No host in objectstack consumes `DashboardWithConfig`, so no persistence path receives the flattened `layoutW`/`layoutH` payload and the hazard has no producer. (Caveat recorded honestly: the cloud repo was not searchable from this session; if cloud hosts the component, that is the reopen path.)

Reopen trigger: any host adopts `DashboardWithConfig` and persists its `onWidgetSave` payload (the strict `DashboardWidgetSchema` will refuse `layoutW`/`layoutH` loudly at that moment) — then the fix is un-flattening in `handleWidgetSave` before forwarding, exactly as the round-trip pin in objectstack#7129's test does. Maintainer veto: reopen is free.
